title: Tell us what you want to post.
body: Three fields. One email. You get the image and caption right here — and a copy in your inbox.

topic.label: What's it about?
topic.placeholder: e.g. pricing talks with existing clients
topic.help: One sentence is enough. Max. 280 characters.

expertise.label: Your role or industry
expertise.help: Helps us match the tone. Max. 120 characters.

tone.label: Which tone?
tone.help: Pick a style — it shapes the whole post.

color.label: Background
color.help: Pick a color combo — or let us choose automatically.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.help: This is how your name appears in the sample post.

email.label: Where do we send the copy?
email.help: For this post only. No spam.
email.invalidError: That doesn't look like a valid email.

consent.label: I agree my email is used to deliver this post.
consent.requiredError: We need your OK to deliver the post.

form.loadingHelp: Takes around 30 seconds. Keep this window open.

idle.headline: Your post will appear here.
idle.body: Fill in the fields on the left — we build hook, image and caption in under a minute.

loading.headline: We're building your post …
loading.body: Picking hook, structure and image layout. Seconds, not minutes.

error.headline: Something went wrong.
error.body: We couldn't build the post just now. Try again — your input is saved.

customPost.headline: This is what it looks like when the workflow is yours.
customPost.context: A real post from my internal workflow — own branding, own visual language, own voice. From a single command.
customPost.prompt: Let's check if this is feasible for your social media content workflow.
customPost.ctaAriaLabel: Get in touch to check your own content workflow

post.caption:
SEO often gets reduced to rankings, keywords, and technical checks.

All of that matters. But visibility alone does not solve an inquiry problem.

When someone lands on an offer page through Google, there is already intent behind the visit. That person is looking for a solution, an assessment, or a provider who fits the situation.

That is exactly when the page needs to make the offer clear, build enough trust, and point to a useful next step.

If you want your offer page to be not only more visible, but also clearer for the right inquiries, feel free to send me a DM or briefly describe your project through the website.

More here:
{{link}}
